cl100h_alignment.selection_reason: Two abrupt increases of the mean cone-to-substrate LVDT displacement, accompanied by force drops, correspond to short DOFS loss-of-correlation episodes and persistent regional response changes. Use the first event to estimate a constant offset and the second to check it; do not fit a strain-load constitutive curve to synchronize records.
cl100h_alignment.time_map: t_DOFS_shared = t_DAT + offset_s. Convert each regional pair-local time to the earliest of the four CL100H DOFS start timestamps before estimating or applying the offset. B2_observation_results.json records those timestamps.
cl100h_alignment.interval_meaning: DOFS event is bracketed by complete regional records immediately before and after the first missing-data run in the stated window. This is a sampling/event correspondence bracket, not a statistical confidence interval or a synchronized acquisition guarantee.
cl100h_alignment.same_force_probe_reason: An intermediate force crossed on both sides of the global peak tests whether instantaneous force alone defines a unique regional response. The branch is selected from the loading record, not from the size of a strain discrepancy.

engineering_alignment.selection_reason: Hundred-kN crossings span the measured loading branch and available post-peak branch. Keep missing regional observations and absent crossings; preserve the full acquired path for subsequent model work. The pre-existing 300-kN paired probe is the same-force history comparison. These are mechanical stages, not elastic or damage labels.

physical_geometry.source: references/papers/jansson2024_dataset/full.md sections 4.1-4.3; source.pdf Figure 3. The cone bottom radius is from jansson2025_lining section 2.1 and must be revisited if the outstanding corrigendum changes that geometry.
physical_geometry.outer_shape: symmetric octagon; a regular-octagon geometry is a modeling idealization
physical_geometry.support_note: Four rod/plate restraints and two trestles act on the coupled substrate/top-layer system. Their finite support areas and compliance remain to be represented; the whole 1 m square perimeter is not a clamped boundary.

material_use.cubes: Compression force divided by each recorded loaded area gives cube compressive strength. Machine piston stroke is not a local extensometer and does not directly provide Young modulus.
material_use.tensile_cores: Retain measured force and machine displacement. Core area and per-core failure location are not present in these files; do not turn peak force into an interface traction-separation law.
material_use.wedge_splitting: Retain both Split_force and Ch 1 Force with their original signs and CMOD. Specimen ligament geometry and the calibration of Split_force must be verified before identifying tensile softening or fracture energy.
